extension.title: Extension
extension.hero_desc: The extension sends detected videos to Abrek Download via local bridge. Captures are listed in real-time when the app is open.
extension.brave_step1: In Brave, type brave://extensions in the address bar. If using Chrome, chrome://extensions.
extension.brave_step2: Turn on Developer mode in the top right.
extension.brave_step4: Select the extension folder below. It installs immediately.
extension.brave_tip: Tip: Pin the extension icon to your toolbar. You can see captures from the popup and download in one click.
extension.firefox_step1: Type about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox in the address bar.
extension.firefox_step3: Select the manifest.json file in the folder below. Alternatively use the dist/Abrek-Download-firefox.xpi built by the helper.
extension.firefox_helper_started: Opening Firefox and the extension folder. Follow the steps on the about:debugging page.
extension.firefox_helper_missing: firefox-eklenti.sh was not found. Check the project folder.
extension.firefox_helper_failed: Could not open the Firefox helper: {error}
extension.firefox_note: Easiest route: use the button below; it builds the XPI, opens Firefox's about:debugging page and the extension folder. Temporary extensions are removed when Firefox closes; reload each session. Do not install the unsigned XPI via about:addons; Firefox reports it as corrupt. Permanent install requires AMO signing (details in the script output).
extension.test_desc: Check whether the local bridge used by the extension is reachable.
extension.test_invalid_resp: Bridge responded but health status is invalid.
extension.disclaimer: Abrek Download should only be used for content you have the right to download. DRM-protected streams cannot be downloaded.

cli.help:
Abrek Download {version}

Usage:
  abrek-download [URL]

Options:
  -h, --help      Show this help
  -V, --version   Show version

If a URL is given, it is queued when the app starts.
If the app is already running, the link is sent to the running queue.
